quote.text: All he had to do was smile and wave, maybe lean into the curmudgeonly/avuncular (and less self-evidently toxic) "boss" persona and learn to laugh at himself just a little bit, like George Steinbrenner did, and New Yorkers would've fallen for it hook, line, and sinker.
